usedFor: MyDocSafe holds your documents for signing, and Conversion Chats messages the signer when “Document is Signed” runs “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Document is Signed” in MyDocSafe, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: Once all parties have signed, a templated message goes out through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: Each MyDocSafe event needs its own template wording, so a rejected signature should not reuse the signed message.
